items.summary: Maintain a small site-factory pipeline for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. No domain, spend, deployment, publication, credentials, tracking, or affiliate activation is authorized. Each candidate requires a verified site brief, reusable template scope, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics and affiliate readiness, compliance checklist, security evidence, owner decision, measurement plan, and rollback plan before implementation or launch. Delivery capacity is saturated, so preserve existing readiness work and do not create duplicate implementation requests.
